This micro hardness tester features a built-in CCD camera for standardized automatic length measurement. Hardness can be measured simply and accurately with easy-touse PC software. The lineup also includes fully automated (FA) machines equipped with an electrically driven revolver mechanism and electrically driven XYZ. A manual machine with an optical head and models with color cameras are also included in the lineup. 
Features
 Excellent Automatic Reading Function (G31 Series)
Standardized automatic length measurement function using a digital camera built into a novel G frame (G31 series)
 Easy-to-use software (G31 series)
The main sequence of operations is laid out in a way that is easy to visualize, so the system can be used easily by anyone.
 Automated Testing with the Electric Stage (FA Series)
Compatible with an XY stage equipped with an electric micrometer (G31 series)
 Capable of automatically recognizing the full sample image and the sample edges (G31-FA series)
